title: Nexus BatchUpdateFindingsRequest
description: Request body for PATCH /v1/daemon/findings/batch. Bulk-updates status and/or target_executor for up to 100 findings. Creator-scoped; each individual update reuses the existing update_finding DAO validation.

finding_ids.description: IDs of the findings to update. Must be unique; cap enforced at 100; >100 returns HTTP 422 with code `too_many_findings`.
